name: The courier on the quay
description: Finn Alder's lines come from the game's text service (Codex storyteller) and the portraits from its image service (Codex image backend), generated 2026-11-02 (the quay backdrop is a Codex refresh of the game's quay picture). A portrait card on the screen and a portrait on the phone.

caption.speaker: Finn Alder
caption.text: The harbour stays busy even in the rain. At dusk the quay turns slick under the lanterns, while merchants drift up toward the market road.

phone.goal: Find out who the packet is for
narration: Finn won't say who sealed the packet. "I can't tell you that, friend. Not with a hand already resting on a scimitar nearby."
He fears whoever followed him from an unlisted ship.
